A '''wolf-like creature''' lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. At least one of these creatures made its home on the [[Floating Mountain]], where the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being called [[Gracca]] turned it into pure [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]<ref name="TCC">{{Ewoks|The Crystal Cloak}}</ref> at some point prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, which include the events of "The Crystal Cloak," to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
